name: a5r
description: A5R (Agent 5 Rules): Hai's S2 flow beside Ather Automata, which it never changes. A5R off: Ather exactly as it ships, plus the 🟥/⏯️ title marks. /a5r on: the five rules (D9), checked at the action only for what cannot be undone and at A5R acceptance only at the end of the checklist (a PR through gh or an MCP tool once every row of the tracked intent is met or waived, Ather's Ship prompt, an intent close, and after the fact for a PR listed then; it never asks: a failing score refuses with its list and /a5r pass lets one through; a card in the A5R pane); a lapsed Editor lease with no Editor running is released and a grant its session never saw passes on, and coordination for the sessions sharing one S2 checkout: Editor holder (queue, leases, the S2 standard's lock lines), RAM (safe cleanup, launch and PIE gates), Sync main holder (cutoff, a freeze that is a lease with a hard end, a sync worker that runs the merge, the MERGE_HEAD guard, conflicts to their owners), with a5r notices that never enter intent files, one compact A5R line of icons and values in Ather's pane (★ A5R › on seal red) and an A5R pane of its own (/a5r, all in English): a thin seal-red band, one tools list, the open sessions, the acceptance card and five rule chips that open a card each; one-shot pixel dithers on the desktop.

a5rWhenPresent.title: A5R approvals when you are here
a5rWhenPresent.description: ask: a dialog asks you before a destructive git/fs command or a shared-config edit runs; deny: the agent is refused and must ask you to run it. A worker (subagent) is never asked: it is refused and reports. During an Ather away window the question goes to its ledger as a D-<n> and the call is refused.

motion.title: Pixel motion in Ather's pane
motion.description: on: a tile's pixel icon dithers in when its state turns over, the Branch icon sweeps while a sync runs, the A5R seal stamps in, the A5R pane's blocks dither in from red pixels when it opens (within 0.3 s) and events dither once; slow: the same, with the pane's entrance and the event dithers ten times slower (about 3 s), for checking the animations on the real pane; off: every icon stays still.

launchGatePieGb.title: A5R Editor launch gate, slot with PIE (GB free)
launchGatePieGb.description: Free RAM, after the safe cleanup, a slot with PIE needs before the Editor is launched (an Editor already open is reused). /a5r gate <with PIE> <without PIE> moves it for every session; /a5r gate reset returns to this value. The PIE gate itself (start at 5 GB, abort under 3 GB) is fixed.

launchGateGb.title: A5R Editor launch gate, slot without PIE (GB free)
launchGateGb.description: Free RAM, after the safe cleanup, a slot without PIE needs before the Editor is launched.

syncMergeMinutes.title: A5R Sync main: freeze length for a merge (minutes)
syncMergeMinutes.description: The freeze from the sync time is a lease: past this many minutes without done or abort the sync expires, git and the Editor open again for every session, and Hai gets a 🟥.

syncBuildMinutes.title: A5R Sync main: freeze length for a merge with a build (minutes)
syncBuildMinutes.description: The same hard end for a sync planned with a build (/a5r sync HH:MM build, or Build: on in the panel's Sync ⋯ dialog).

pendingFile.title: Pending decisions file
pendingFile.description: Where 🟥 decisions outside Ather's records are appended (an intent's director call is in Ather's Needs you instead); empty means %USERPROFILE%/.claude/PENDING.md.
